name: Guidance Laws and Algorithms
summary: Algorithms that decide where a vehicle should go and how to steer there, for ascent, orbit transfer, entry, landing and intercept.

topics.name: Guidance concepts: open-loop, closed-loop, explicit and implicit guidance
Ascent guidance: linear tangent steering and Powered Explicit Guidance (PEG)
Iterative guidance mode (Saturn) and upper-stage guidance
Lambert and targeting-based guidance for orbital transfers
Entry guidance: Apollo and Shuttle entry guidance, predictor-corrector methods
Powered descent guidance: Apollo polynomial guidance and convex (G-FOLD) guidance
